title: Publish a roster
text: Publish the roster from Schedule after every shift has an assigned team. Publishing sends a notification to scheduled staff.

title: Save a draft roster
text: Save draft stores an unpublished schedule. Employees continue to see the last published roster until a planner publishes a revision.

title: Approve a shift swap
text: A shift swap requires supervisor approval after both employees accept the exchange. The existing assignments stay in place until approval.

title: Withdraw a swap request
text: An employee can withdraw a pending swap from My Requests. An approved swap requires a planner to change the assignments.

title: View leave balance
text: Open Leave and choose Balance to see the current annual allowance and approved deductions. Pending requests appear separately.

title: Withdraw leave
text: Open the leave request and select Withdraw while approval is pending. Ask a supervisor to amend an approved absence.

title: Offline clock entries
text: The terminal queues offline clock entries. Queued entries synchronize after network connectivity returns.

title: Correct a missed clock entry
text: Submit a time correction for a missed clock entry with the actual start or finish time. A supervisor reviews the correction.

title: Payroll export cutoff
text: The payroll export includes approved entries through the cutoff date. Late approvals enter the following export.

title: Repeat an export
text: Download a previous payroll export from Export History using its batch identifier. Reusing the identifier preserves the original export.

title: Activate a staff account
text: A new staff member activates an account through the invitation email. A planner can resend an expired invitation from Team Settings.

title: Change display language
text: Open Personal Settings and choose Display Language. The preference applies only to the signed-in employee.

title: Reconcile delayed terminal batches
text: Support analysts reconcile delayed terminal batches by comparing the receipt sequence with the ingestion journal before replay.

title: Freeze a payroll connector
text: A support supervisor can freeze the payroll connector after an integrity alarm. Record the incident identifier before resuming delivery.

title: Rebuild the search index
text: Support can rebuild the search index against the approved catalog revision. Verify the source count after indexing.

title: Locked planning period
text: A locked planning period prevents further roster edits. A planner requests an unlock from the scheduling supervisor.
